sentences.text: Alexander Emerick Jones -LRB- born February 11 , 1974 -RRB- is an American far-right radio show host , filmmaker , writer , and conspiracy theorist .	far-right	far-right	conspiracy theorist	Conspiracy theory

He hosts The Alex Jones Show from Austin , Texas , which airs on the Genesis Communications Network and shortwave radio station WWCR across the United States and online .	Genesis Communications Network	Genesis Communications Network	shortwave radio	shortwave radio	WWCR	WWCR
His website , InfoWars.com , has been labeled as a fake news website .	fake news website	fake news website

Jones has been the center of many controversies , including his statements in the wake of the Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting , about it being staged , adding support to Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting conspiracy theories , and as an argument against gun control .	conspiracy theories	Conspiracy theory	Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting	Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting	Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting conspiracy theories	Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting conspiracy theories	gun control	gun control

He has accused the U.S. government of being involved in the Oklahoma City bombing , the September 11 attacks and the filming of fake Moon landings to hide NASA 's secret technology .	Oklahoma City bombing	Oklahoma City bombing	September 11 attacks	September 11 attacks	fake Moon landings	Moon landing conspiracy theories	NASA	NASA

He says that government and big business have colluded to create a New World Order through `` manufactured economic crises , sophisticated surveillance tech and -- above all -- inside-job terror attacks that fuel exploitable hysteria '' .	New World Order	New World Order (conspiracy theory)

Jones has described himself as a libertarian and paleoconservative , and has been described by others as conservative , right-wing , alt-right , and a pro-Russia propagandist .	libertarian	libertarianism	paleoconservative	paleoconservatism	conservative	Conservatism in the United States	right-wing	Right-wing politics	alt-right	alt-right	pro-Russia	Russophilia

New York magazine described Jones as `` America 's leading conspiracy theorist '' , and the Southern Poverty Law Center describes him as `` the most prolific conspiracy theorist in contemporary America '' .	conspiracy theorist	Conspiracy theory	New York	New York (magazine)	Southern Poverty Law Center	Southern Poverty Law Center
